build_UNetModel: build a UNetModel with timestep embedding and attention for diffusion-based image generation
build_AsymmetricUNetModel: build an AsymmetricUNetModel with a decoder that has twice as many blocks as the encoder
build_SuperResModel: build a SuperResModel UNet that conditions on a low-resolution image for super-resolution
build_EncoderUNetModel: build an EncoderUNetModel half UNet with adaptive pooling for feature extraction
build_AttentionPool2d: build an AttentionPool2d module with QKV attention pooling adapted from CLIP
